test_title: PYST 4: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 5 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option in which the pair of letter-clusters share the same relationship as that shared by the given pair of letter-clusters.

CRO : FUR :: ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : ​(3) is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series.

​Given :

 
• CRO : FUR

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b587ded6939a0527b072fd0cabdcdf6cdb215b01b4c27100862d311ff7fac07a.png] 

​So,

 
• Option - (1) : MIP : PLT​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d50332745297aa023b4b2aa02f33f54ad4438a550fef10ab9701c8b7e7f45cf.png] 

 
• Option - (2) : FMG : HPJ

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba0318d54dc659d59c1bc0de450eab2357a7306e0a72358a5e1906e70a3f948b.png] 

 
• Option - (3) : LAP : ODT

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9fe837cd13ebb7d0eb14acf8bed2daaa222e2c56b11e09b7f502d83bbb6bcd90.png] 

 
• Option - (4) : TCS : WFV

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a537aa7c35495a41e435a344824b694018503329f016af928644de37cbcdc54.png] 

Here, Only "TCS : WFV" follows the same pattern as given.

Hence, "**TCS : WFV**" is the correct answer.
